scope: Read-only re-review of the six final client-feedback/solo-bots helpers, tests and verifiers after the first fix cycle.
summary: Docker authorization validates local endpoints before output/dependency/daemon effects, rejects inherited contexts, pins every daemon command, and preserves explicit non-remote Podman. Privacy checks, artifact purge, roster input assertions and inert CLI tests have no blocking findings. Archived live evidence is correctly distinguished from maintained hardened tools.
nonblocking_suggestions: Record imported-helper hashes in future runtime evidence, rather than only the main verifier hash.

Add process-level cases for Docker discovery returning remote endpoints or malformed output; code already rejects these before output creation, but current process tests do not directly cover both discovery branches.
verification_boundary: Reviewer performed static reading only; actual Node tests and hardened local browser replay were separately executed by the parent. No runtime, browser, container or public actions were performed by the reviewer.
